notes: Direct fetches of jd2.com, support.jd2.com and roguefab.com failed (DNS blocked in this environment). EVERY maker fact was taken from WebSearch result summaries of the listed jd2.com / roguefab.com pages, not from a direct page read. Please re-check on the live pages before publishing. Conflicts flagged in the article: (1) M605 max wall .188" (product page/catalogue) vs .250" DOM (FAQ); (2) M605 per-stroke angle 94 vs 90 deg on different Rogue pages; (3) M605 max bend listed as both 194 and 195 deg; (4) M605 solid bar 1-1/2" (spec table) vs 2" (one Tradesman package page). Also noted in research but only partly used: Rogue's comparison page says JD2 does not sell a hydraulic kit for the Model 32, which contradicts JD2's own listing of a Model 32 hydraulic adapter kit (SKU 302003); the article follows JD2's listing. JD2's Model 32 hydraulic is listed both 'Includes Cylinder' and 'Cylinder NOT Included' (two SKUs); the article tells readers to check the package. JD2 electric pump URL says '1-hp' but listing title says 1-1/2 HP; article uses the title (1-1/2 HP). 'Horizontal' label for the Model 32 is attributed to Rogue Fab's comparison page (a competitor). JD2 pump compressor spec (20 cfm, 110-175 psi) and Rogue air ram (about 6 CFM at 110 psi, 125 psi compressor, 30+ gal tank) come from search summaries of the product listings. Left out (unverified): JD2 frame max bend angle (JD2 publishes none; only 180-deg die sets), a separate 4130 wall rating for either machine, M605 square-tube capacity, weights, warranty for JD2. SWAG ram mount is a third-party part; the article tells readers to ask JD2 about warranty. No prices used.
